steps.SIM_SRC_NO_NETWORK: The source has no network interface with an address or a cable.
steps.SIM_DST_NO_NETWORK: The target has no network interface with an address or a cable.
steps.SIM_LOCAL: Same host — the traffic never leaves the machine.
steps.SIM_L2_TO_TARGET: Delivered to the target over VLAN {segment}.
steps.SIM_L2_NO_PATH: No cable path carries VLAN {segment} to the next hop.
steps.SIM_L2_CLIENT_ISOLATION: Wi-Fi “{ssid}” isolates clients: stations on it cannot reach each other directly.
steps.SIM_L2_OTHER_SEGMENT: The next hop is on another VLAN than {segment}.
steps.SIM_L3_NO_SUBNET: The source address belongs to no subnet in the project.
steps.SIM_L3_NO_GATEWAY: Subnet {subnet} has no gateway on any device.
steps.SIM_L3_NEXT_HOP_UNSUPPORTED: {router} forwards via {via}; routing over several routers is not simulated yet.
steps.SIM_FW_DEFAULT_ALLOW: No rule matches; {router} allows by default.
steps.SIM_FW_DEFAULT_DENY: No rule matches; {router} denies by default ({from} → {to}).
steps.SIM_VPN_TUNNEL: VPN clients of {zone} come in through the tunnel on {router}.
steps.SIM_VPN_NAT: VPN clients of {zone} are masqueraded by {server}: the network sees {server}.
steps.SIM_VPN_INTERNET: Internet access of {zone} clients depends on their tunnel (split or full) — not simulated.
steps.SIM_VPN_NOT_TARGET: VPN clients take connections only through their tunnel.
steps.SIM_HOSTFW_OUT_RULE_ALLOW: {host} lets it out by outgoing rule #{rule}.
steps.SIM_HOSTFW_OUT_DEFAULT_DENY: No outgoing rule matches; {host} drops outgoing {protocol}/{port} by default.
steps.SIM_NAT_NONE_IPV6: IPv6 is routed by {router} as it is — no address translation.
steps.SIM_IPV6_GLOBAL: {subnet} is a global IPv6 prefix: the internet can address its hosts directly.
steps.SIM_IPV6_LOCAL_ONLY: {subnet} is a local IPv6 prefix (ULA): not routed on the internet.
steps.SIM_HOSTFW_RULE_ALLOW: Allowed by host firewall rule #{rule} on {host}.
steps.SIM_HOSTFW_RULE_DENY: Blocked by host firewall rule #{rule} on {host} ({protocol}/{port}).
steps.SIM_HOSTFW_DEFAULT_ALLOW: No host firewall rule matches; {host} accepts incoming traffic by default.
steps.SIM_HOSTFW_DEFAULT_DENY: No host firewall rule matches; {host} drops incoming {protocol}/{port} by default.
steps.SIM_FW_INTRA_ZONE_DENY: Inside zone {from} — traffic between subnets is denied.
steps.SIM_NAT_MISSING: No masquerade (source NAT) on {router} {interface} for this zone.
steps.SIM_WAN_NO_UPLINK: {interface} is not connected to the Internet.
steps.SIM_DOCKER_NAT: Docker network {network} — NAT through the host.
steps.SIM_DOCKER_INTERNAL: Docker network {network} is internal — no traffic leaves it.
steps.SIM_FLOW_UNBOUND: Nobody plays the role “{role}” — pick a participant.
steps.SIM_FROM_INTERNET: Connections from the internet start at a port forward — check them in the Access view.
steps.SIM_INTERNET_INBOUND: A connection from the internet arrives at {interface} ({protocol}/{port}).
steps.SIM_NAT_TARGET_MISSING: The port forward of port {port} on {router} has no valid target or WAN interface.

fix.title: Suggested fix

access.noServices: No apps with listening ports in this project.

verdict.blocked: Flow blocked · {count, plural, one {# hop} other {# hops}}
verdict.unknown: Flow incomplete · {count, plural, one {# hop} other {# hops}}

flows.skipped: {count, plural, one {# optional step} other {# optional steps}} skipped — no participant.

failures.hint: Take devices or cables down — or cut the power — and see who loses the internet or their apps. Devices behind a UPS keep running in a power cut.
failures.powerCut: Power cut (only devices on a UPS keep running)
failures.down: {devices, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}} and {links, plural, one {# cable} other {# cables}} down.
failures.internetLost: {count, plural, one {# loses} other {# lose}} the internet: {names}
failures.appCutOff: {app}: {count, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}} cut off ({names})
failures.assertion: Assertion “{name}” {result, select, true {now holds} false {now fails} other {can no longer be checked}}
failures.noSpof: No single device or cable cuts anything off on its own.
failures.spofHidden: {count, plural, one {# endpoint hidden} other {# endpoints hidden}} — a failure that cuts off only that device and what runs on it.
